notes: InstallMethod::SkillsSh, global scope, requested harnesses = [] (universal root only). No LICENSE file accompanies this fixture: vercel-labs/agent-skills (checked at the recorded source_commit via the GitHub API) carries no LICENSE file upstream, so there is nothing to vendor. What SKILL.md content this skill DID have is not on disk either: its body under skills/<name>/ is stored as a one-line stub (`stub sha256=<original hash> bytes=<n>`), never the real content; tree.json still records the ORIGINAL sha256/length, and cli_parity.rs compares against that original hash, not the stub's own bytes.
